name: loading-state
title: Loading State
summary: A compact loader with an elapsed timer for long-running agent work.
description: A compact loader for long-running agent work: a pixel grid, a shimmering label and an elapsed timer. The 3×3 grid draws a chevron wavefront (drive / dots) or a comet lapping the perimeter (orbit); the timer is in mono tabular figures.

anatomy.description: The real Shimmer (fast), marked data-loading-state="label"; truncates, full text in title
aria-hidden: the ticking time is never announced

label.description: Status text; also the region's accessible name.

elapsed.description: Formatted elapsed time from the host. When omitted, the adapters tick it from mount (7.9s · 1m 2.0s · 1h 12m).

notes: The root is a role=status region named by the label; changing the label is announced once.
The elapsed time is aria-hidden so its 100ms ticks are never announced; the pixel grid is aria-hidden.

motion: cells: fndn-pixel-on loop (opacity only), 650ms (orbit 950ms) with easing ease, staggered 90ms (orbit 110ms) through literal loop delays; keeps pulsing under reduced motion (it is the loading signal)
label: our shimmer at its fast speed (1.4s loop); the shimmer stops under reduced motion and shows static ink-2 text
no entrance and no other motion; the timer ticks in tabular figures so nothing shifts
